attempts.notes: success=false at create; start reported 'Required resources are currently unavailable'; destroyed before any setup.
Accepted host. No docker inside the instance, so the packaged image cannot be built there. Destroyed after the image delivery route was identified as the blocker; no science was run.
Created with --ssh; the provider injected sshd into a container that has none and never started the workload. Destroyed after the pull completed.

Entrypoint mode. The wrapper ran but exited with 'cloud attempt failed'; /proc/1/environ contained no COFOLD_CLOUD_SPEC. Cause: --env needs docker syntax '-e KEY=VALUE'; a bare KEY=VALUE is parsed as a port mapping.
Accepted launch: image pull, then the assets stage downloading the 24.9 GiB asset set.
17 Gbps host, but the 24 GB image did not finish pulling within 32 minutes; destroyed under the 30-minute image budget.

Image pulled in 366 s (fast host). The wrapper failed at the create-only claim because attempt-5de1cb5a8f8840248959d1b07c5eaf26 was already claimed by the destroyed 3090 run; started.json existed in R2. A spent attempt needs a freshly prepared job.

Acceptance run: image pull 214 s, inputs 0.3 s, assets 304.5 s, worker 57.2 s. CYP3A4 + heme + ligand and Trp-cage/ethanol both completed with one checkpoint load; peak reserved 20.6 GB of 33.7 GB. Archive 424,345,600 bytes, sha256 5fc943ef1ae895b40146d8c3692619bd1268c7a2aa6dde8f2d5bd63423c1a63e.

blocker: The 23.9 GB container image cannot be delivered to the provider: GHCR push needs write:packages (token has gist, read:org, repo, workflow) and anonymous ttl.sh rejects the large blob upload with a commit timeout.
